title: Gradient Graffiti Text
coreRelationships: The vibrant gradient text strongly contrasts with the dark, almost black, background.
The distressed texture of the letters and the paint drips create a sense of decay and rawness.
The horizontal gradient progression across the text provides a dynamic visual flow.
The vertical paint drips emphasize the 'graffiti' and 'spray paint' aesthetic.
reuseFormula: Apply a bold, uppercase, distressed graffiti-style font to the desired text. Fill the text with a multi-color, high-saturation gradient that transitions horizontally. Add varying lengths and thicknesses of paint drips extending downwards from the letters. Place this text on a solid, dark, low-saturation background to maximize contrast and impact.
